title: Halcyon Drift Rising Revisited
author: Ada Whitlock
blurb: Astrid Zhou, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
